thread:
liam_infra: Heads up — pool29/card5 is showing a steady uplift in row-remap counts over the last 72h. Xid errors are creeping up too. Dash: https://dash.internal/pool29/card5 (trend). Should we soft-drain and put on a watchlist or start replacement?

sophia_sre: can you paste the raw counts? ECC vs remap split?

liam_infra: copying the quick dump from monitoring:
```
timestamp: 2025-03-12T02:12:00Z
remap_count: 74  (24h +38%)
page_retire_count: 29
ecc_corrected: 5
xid_errors: 12
first_spike: 2025-03-09
last_cleared_log: kernel: DRM: GPU fault lru miss
```
Not huge single-bit ECC but remaps + page retires trending. Kernel logs show a few LRU/kernel abort lines.

jamie_ops: we have 2 spare GPUs in pool29 (usw1) right now. Soft-drain for a short canary should be safe but keep an eye on queue growth. If we drain and QPS spikes we might need burst capacity.

alex_planning: tagging INF-3421 and adding this as a watchlist candidate. Who can run the nvml mem diag?

infra-bot: :robot_face: Auto-detect: remap rate over threshold for pool29/card5. Watchlist entry created: watch/pool29/card5/1762345678.

liam_infra: I'll run the mem diagnostic now. Command I plan to use:
```
ssh node-pool29-05
sudo /opt/tools/gpu_mem_diag.py --card 5 --full-memtest --duration 4h --out /var/log/gpu/card5-memtest.log
```
If the memtest shows persistent page retire events we'll escalate to replacement.

sophia_sre: agree with soft-drain + memtest. If remap_count increases > 15 in next 24h or xids continue to appear, mark for page-retire candidate and schedule hardware swap. Also check for correlated host-level OOMs or driver upgrades applied recently.

jamie_ops: I'll schedule a 1h soft drain at 23:00 UTC tonight and notify on-call. Plan: cordon -> migrate low-priority tasks -> keep job eviction threshold conservative. Leaving a 3h rollback window. :thumbsup:

liam_infra: done. memtest kicked off, logs streaming to /var/log/gpu/card5-memtest.log. Posting tail here in ~30m if anything obvious shows up.

alex_planning: note on capacity/cost — if we end up doing a replacement across zone we should prefer same performance type N1->N1 to avoid rebalancing. Replacement parts lead-time is ~48h from vendor.

sophia_sre: also add a short eval workload after memtest (1h low-latency chat inference) to ensure KV cache behavior hasn't regressed post-retry.

liam_infra: quick tail (sample):
```
[02:42:31] kernel: nvidia: page retire triggered for page 0x7f9a... remap_count=3
[02:42:35] nvml: info: ECC single-bit corrected: 1
[03:10:02] nvml: warning: Xid 79 on GPU 5
```
Not huge but consistent.

jamie_ops: reaction :eyes: — monitoring dashboards alerted ops. I'll escalate to hardware team if memtest fails.

infra-bot: Watchlist update: pool29/card5 -> status: soft-draining (scheduled 2025-03-12T23:00:00Z), memtest running.

liam_infra: TL;DR — soft-drain scheduled, memtest running, watchlist entry created. If no improvement after 48h -> hard drain & RMA. Attaching logs to INF-3421 once memtest completes.

sophia_sre: +1. Keep the watchlist tag. If anyone sees remap spikes on sister cards in the rack, call it out — could be host heat or PSU related.

jamie_ops: will monitor queue depth & cost metrics during the drain. I'll post an update after the 23:00 run.

liam_infra: thanks all.
